# catalog { #labdata.catalog }

```python
labdata.catalog(refresh=False, max_age=3600.0, cfg=None, progress=False)
```

Get the catalog, rescanning only when needed.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**refresh**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [False]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Rescan the repositories even if a fresh catalog is on disk.

<code>[**max_age**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[float](`float`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [3600.0]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Age in seconds beyond which the stored catalog is rescanned.

<code>[**cfg**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[Config](`labdata.config.Config`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Settings. Defaults to [](`labdata.config.Config.load`). A stored catalog built with different settings is rescanned rather than reused.

<code>[**progress**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [False]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Show a progress bar while rescanning. Nothing is drawn when the stored catalog is used, since there is nothing to wait for.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[List](`typing.List`)\[[Entry](`labdata.model.Entry`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Entries sorted by repository and path.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
for entry in catalog():
    print(entry.spec, entry.latest.size)
```
